steps.label: unpack
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && [ "$(md5 -q nw/nw_bundle1.tgz)" = 309d2ef00c2fa64e22c6678f09a3cba7 ] && [ "$(md5 -q nw/nw_mix.m4a)" = 2310604672dec7e1c8ad588bb65c8c3c ] && rm -rf nw/bundle && mkdir -p nw/bundle && tar xzf nw/nw_bundle1.tgz -C nw/bundle && for f in nw/bundle/*.js; do [ -f "$f.map" ] || echo '{"version":3,"sources":[],"names":[],"mappings":""}' > "$f.map"; done && ls nw/bundle/public | wc -l

steps.label: render
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion render nw/bundle P nw_out.mp4 --gl=angle --crf=18 --muted --concurrency=6 --timeout=180000 --log=error

steps.label: mux
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i nw_out.mp4 -i nw/nw_mix.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a copy nw_film.mp4 && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i nw_film.mp4 -vf scale=1280:720 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 27 -c:a aac -b:a 128k nw_720.mp4 && ls -l nw_film.mp4 nw_720.mp4 > nw_done1.txt; cat nw_done1.txt
